manifest_row.title: Trump Administration Seeks to Block Settlement Between Sierra Club and Michigan Utility

screening.main_topic: A Justice Department challenge to a Sierra Club settlement that would require a Michigan utility to close coal-fired power plants and fund local environmental improvements.
screening.climate_relevance: The article notes that the plant closures would reduce greenhouse-gas emissions that cause climate change and discusses the administration's position on how environmental laws apply to climate change. These points are relevant but secondary to the legal dispute.
screening.reason: The main focus is the scope of citizen groups' role in Clean Air Act enforcement and the proposed settlement's terms, rather than climate change itself.
